newsitem.title: THAILAND: National Fertilizer lists at 12 baht/shr.
newsitem.headline: National Fertilizer lists at 12 baht/shr.

text.p: National Fertilizer Plc made its debut on the Thai stock exchange at 12 baht per share, down four baht from its initial public offering price of 16 baht.
By 0304 GMT, the stock had fallen further to 11.75 baht per share and was the most active counter trading on the exchange.
"National Fertilizer is not that attractive because most of the major shareholders are state-enterprises," said one analyst.

Major shareholders of the company include state-enterprises Petroleum Authority of Thailand, the Government Savings Bank, the Finance Ministry, Crown Property Bureau and the Industrial Finance Corp of Thailand.
The stock had eased to 11.25 baht at 0315 GMT.
